CAHSR has spent roughly $16B since 2008, completed 90+ miles of guideway, and is only now starting track. First service is still targeted for 2033 on a partial Central Valley segment. Full SF-LA remains years and tens of billions away.

Boring has already carried 4M+ passengers on operational Vegas tunnels built in a fraction of the time and cost. With Prufrock machines targeting a mile a week, multiple concurrent digs, and private-sector execution, major usable segments would almost certainly be running passengers by now instead of waiting for the first rails.
